Description

This gigantic burrowing insect has an oversized abdomen. A terrifying set of long, hooked mandibles protrudes from its head.

Defense

AC 19, touch 9; flat-footed 19 (+10 natural, -1 size)

hp 68 [104] (8d10+24)

Fort +9, Ref +6, Will +2

Immune Mind-affecting effects

Resist earth 10

Weakness Water

Offense

Speed 30 ft.; Burrow 10 ft.

Melee Bite +13 (2d8+7 plus grab)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Sandblast, Sandpit, Venom Spray

Statistics

Str 20, Dex 11, Con 17, Int 2, Wis 11, Cha 10

Base Atk +8; CMB +14 (+18 grapple); CMD 24 (28 vs. trip)

Feats Improved Initiative, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Focus (Bite)

Skills Perception +17

Gear Sandpearl

description.value: An antlion can stir up the sand around it to blast sand at its enemies within a 30-ft.-radius.
